scope: Push transport cancellation with shared optional ConfirmKillProcess, completed remote/branch-phase reporting and same-model retry. Partial parity; full port remains incomplete.

verification.native: Headless native Push model receiver passed system Git and Git 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. Real wrapper/helper process groups stop; unrelated process survives. Optional confirmation No leaves transport running, Yes stops. Single-remote cancellation, first of two remotes already completed, and branches completed before delayed tags all retain inputs/HEAD/index, omit success callback, report completed work and preserve completed refs. Same-model retry on all three fixtures publishes expected refs using fresh tokens; idle Cancel closes. Private preferences injected; no user preferences written. These are model/Git checks, not physical sheets/window-close/Escape/default-button/layout/theme or screenshots.
verification.iterations: Focused core, native matrix and builds passed without runtime failure. Receiver throwing file read was placed outside precondition autoclosure before compilation.
verification.builds: Unsigned Debug and AppStore builds passed. Both bundle audits and exact bundled NOTICE comparisons passed. All 96 original icons verified. Store --require-git checked 11 universal Git Mach-O files and fixture operations. EditorConfig and IssueRegex audits passed.
verification.documentation: Push/Fetch parity notes, Push/Progress/Settings source inventory and NOTICE updated. Inventory source-pin regression and seven-column CSV validation passed. Local site generated, unpublished.
verification.ci: Added native Push cancellation receiver to macOS workflow. Hosted CI/push unavailable/unverified; no authentication retry.
verification.processes: All core/compiler/native/audit sessions terminal. No main app or displayed window launched. Owned unrelated-process fixtures terminated and reaped on receiver exit. Final app/receiver process audit empty. Four empty owned PushCancellation QA UUID preference files removed; unrelated preferences retained.

Physical prompt/default/Cancel/Escape/window-close/light-dark/accessibility, cancellation during actual server mutation, network credentials/signing/hooks and signed sandbox runtime remain pending. Streaming output, full progress/post-operation UI, chooser/settings/history parity and full application port incomplete.
